title: Work Values Test
description: Explore your work values pattern with practical, scenario-based questions.
instructions: Answer from recent real behavior, not an ideal version of yourself.
If a statement reminds you of a concrete situation, it is usually more useful.
Use the result for reflection and communication, not as a diagnosis.

AUTONOMY.summary: In this Work Values Test, your result is Autonomy. Your answers cluster around the behaviors, needs, or reactions represented by this pattern.
strengths: You can create leverage in tasks that reward Autonomy
You tend to build repeatable strategies

weaknesses: Under pressure, you may overuse one strategy
